status.description: waiting: the owner has a connection request, which waits until they answer it. connected: the half accepted the owner's request. already_connected: the two were connected before. same_kind: the two aren't of different kinds, so nothing is kept. same_group: connecting across groups, the two are in the same group, so nothing is kept. no_group: connecting across groups, and either isn't in a group, so nothing is kept
